📋 12 Entry Points

Migration

Managed Migration — DWP Notice, Deadline, Transitional Protection

UC managed migration process — DWP issues Migration Notice to legacy claimants. 3-month deadline to claim UC or lose legacy benefits. Transitional protection payments — cash and element protection. Migration Notice sequencing — geographic rollout, caseload priority. Voluntary migration vs managed migration. Natural migration via change of circumstances. Deadlines extension for vulnerable claimants. Statutory instrument framework — UC (Transitional Provisions) regulations.

ESA

ESA Migration — Work Capability, Support Group Transition

Employment and Support Allowance migration to UC — contribution-based ESA ends, income-based ESA transitions. Work Capability Assessment migration — existing LCWRA/LCW determinations honoured. Support Group to UC LCWRA mapping. Assessment period alignment. Severe Disability Premium loss — transitional protection. Carer premium migration. ESA youth to UC transition. WRAG group to UC work-related requirements. 12-month reassessment scheduling.

Tax Credits

Tax Credit Closure — WTC/CTC to UC, HMRC Final Awards

Working Tax Credit and Child Tax Credit closure — HMRC to DWP transfer. Final award calculations — annual income assessment to monthly. Self-employed minimum income floor interaction. WTC disability element to UC LCWRA mapping. Childcare element — 85% vs previous 70% support. Tax credit overpayment debt migration. HMRC reconciliation timing. Pension credit interaction. WTC hours rules replaced by UC work conditionality.

Housing

Housing Benefit Transfer — LHA, Social Tenant, Supported Housing

Housing Benefit migration to UC — local authority to DWP transfer. Local Housing Allowance rates — direct payment to landlord default. Social housing — bedroom tax equivalent under UC. Supported housing — exempt accommodation carve-out. Rent verification process. Alternative Payment Arrangements — managed payments to landlords. Housing cost contributions — non-dependant deductions. Service charges treatment. Temporary accommodation interaction.

Pension

Pension Credit Protection — Guarantee Credit, Savings Credit

Pension Credit interaction with UC migration — pensioners not required to claim UC. Guarantee Credit preserved for mixed-age couples. Savings Credit abolition for new claims. Severe Disability Premium protection — SDP transitional element. Mixed-age couple rule — youngest partner age determines benefit. State Pension uprating interaction. Pension age housing costs — HB vs UC. Carer addition preservation. Minimum income guarantee transition.

Vulnerable

Vulnerable Claimant Safeguards — Domestic Abuse, Mental Health, Digital Exclusion

Vulnerable claimant protections during migration — domestic abuse survivors (UR refuges), mental health crisis, homelessness, learning disabilities, addiction. Digital exclusion — telephone claims, face-to-face support, Assisted Digital service. Reasonable adjustments — large print, BSL, translation. Third-party appointee system. Frequent Payment Alternative — fortnightly UC payments. Managed migration extension requests. Universal Support programme — Citizens Advice, local authorities.

Income

Income Support Wind-Down — Carer, Disability, Lone Parent Transition

Income Support closure — carer premium migration to UC carer element. Lone parent IS to UC — childcare element, work conditionality exemption (child under 3). Disability premium migration — SDP transitional element. Bereavement IS to UC — bereavement support payment interaction. IS maternity allowance overlap. Hospital inpatient rules. Capital limits — £16,000 UC threshold vs IS rules. Rapid reclaims — IS terminations during migration.

JSA

JSA Migration — Contribution-Based Preservation, New Style JSA

Jobseeker's Allowance migration — income-based JSA to UC, contribution-based JSA preserved as New Style JSA. NI contribution conditions — Class 1 contributions in last 2 tax years. JSA sanctions migration — existing sanctions honoured under UC. Jobcentre Plus claimant commitment — UC equivalent. Restart Scheme interaction. Youth Obligation — 18-21 year olds. Work search requirements — 35 hours per week. JSA overpayment debt recovery.

Overpayment

Overpayment Migration — Legacy Debt, HMRC Reconciliation, Recovery

Legacy benefit overpayment migration — HB, IS, JSA, ESA debt transfer to UC. HMRC tax credit overpayment reconciliation — annual award vs UC assessment period. Debt recovery priority — DWP vs HMRC vs local authority. Fraud debt — civil penalty, prosecution, benefit sanction. Administrative earnings threshold interaction. UC standard allowance deduction cap — 25% (hardship), 40% (fraud). Bankruptcy/IVA treatment. Write-off criteria. Debt management strategy.

Digital

Digital Journal — UC Online Account, Claimant Commitment, Journal Messages

UC digital journal — online account for claimant communication. Claimant Commitment digital signing — work-related requirements, health commitments, all work requirements. Journal messages — claimant-to-work coach, to-do items. Payment screens — award breakdown, deductions, advance repayments. Change of circumstances — online reporting. Payment schedule visibility. To-do system — appointment reminders, evidence requests. Mobile app integration. Accessibility — screen readers, voice navigation.

Data

Data Governance — HMRC/DWP Interoperability, GDPR Migration

UC migration data governance — HMRC/DWP data sharing gateway. GDPR implications — legacy claimant data migration, consent, lawful basis. Benefits data warehouse — historical records, audit trail. UC journal data retention — 6 years. Cross-government data sharing — local authority, HMRC, DWP. Real-time earnings data — PAYE RTI integration. Capital verification — HMRC/DWP data matching. Fraud intelligence — DWP/HMRC joint fraud unit. Data portability rights — subject access requests.

Parliamentary

Parliamentary — Work and Pensions Committee, UC Inquiry, PQ Evidence

Work and Pensions Select Committee — UC managed migration inquiry. UC migration timetable — parliamentary questions on rollout pace. Transitional protection adequacy — Lords debates. SDP legal challenge — High Court, Court of Appeal. Universal Support funding — parliamentary scrutiny. Migration Notice statistics — monthly publication. Claimant satisfaction surveys. Poverty impact assessment — JRF, CPAG analysis. Benefit cap interaction. Two-child limit scrutiny.

⚡ 8 Transformation Priorities

1. Migration Notice Intelligence

AI-driven migration sequencing — prioritise claimants by vulnerability, legacy benefit complexity, geographic readiness. Predict claimant dropout risk — digital exclusion, mental health, housing instability. Target: migration completion rate from 72% to 92%, vulnerable claimant safeguard rate 100%, Migration Notice to UC claim latency under 6 weeks.

2. Transitional Protection Automation

Automated transitional protection calculation — cash protection, element protection, SDP transitional element. Real-time comparison of legacy award vs UC entitlement. Over/underpayment detection during transition. Annual transitional protection uprating. Target: transitional protection accuracy above 99.5%, calculation time from 45 minutes to 2 minutes, SDP element assignment 100% first-time accuracy.

3. HMRC/DWP Data Reconciliation

Tax credit to UC award reconciliation — annual income vs monthly assessment period. Self-employed minimum income floor transition. Final tax credit award verification. Overpayment debt migration and recovery scheduling. Target: HMRC/DWP data reconciliation completion within 72 hours of UC claim, tax credit overpayment debt migration accuracy above 98%, self-employed income verification 100% automated.

4. Vulnerable Claimant Detection

AI risk scoring for migration vulnerability — domestic abuse indicators, mental health flags, digital exclusion markers, homelessness risk. Automatic deadline extension trigger. Assisted Digital routing — phone, face-to-face, third-party support. Safeguarding referral pipeline. Target: vulnerable claimant identification rate from 60% to 95%, safeguarding referral response time under 48 hours, assisted digital uptake increase 40%.

5. Housing Benefit Migration Engine

Local authority HB to UC housing element migration — rent verification, LHA rate mapping, bedroom tax calculation, supported housing exemption. Landlord direct payment management. Rent arrears detection and Alternative Payment Arrangement trigger. Target: HB to UC housing element migration accuracy above 97%, landlord payment setup within 5 working days, rent arrears prevention rate above 80%.

6. ESA Work Capability Portability

Work Capability Assessment migration from ESA to UC — LCW/LCWRA determination portability. Reassessment schedule management. Support Group to LCWRA mapping verification. WRAG to UC work-related requirements alignment. Target: WCA determination portability accuracy 100%, reassessment scheduling within 12 months of UC claim, LCWRA/LCW mapping errors under 0.1%.

7. Migration Debt Consolidation

Legacy benefit debt consolidation — HB, IS, JSA, ESA, tax credit overpayments unified under UC deduction framework. Cross-government debt priority management. Bankruptcy/IVA treatment coordination. Hardship payment automation. Target: debt consolidation accuracy above 99%, deduction cap compliance 100%, hardship payment turnaround under 5 working days, debt recovery rate increase 25%.

8. Parliamentary Reporting Pipeline

Automated UC migration reporting — Work and Pensions Committee evidence, PQ responses, monthly migration statistics. Claimant outcome tracking — income change, employment impact, poverty transition. Regional migration completion dashboard. Target: monthly automated migration statistics publication, PQ evidence response time from 10 days to 3 days, Work and Pensions Committee evidence production within 5 working days.

🚫 Red Lines (Never Crossed)

  • ❌ No UC Migration Notice issued without vulnerability screening — every Migration Notice must pass through AI vulnerability detection; at-risk claimants get automatic deadline extension and assisted digital routing
  • ❌ No legacy benefit termination without confirmed UC claim — DWP cannot terminate legacy benefits unless a verified UC claim has been submitted and is progressing through assessment
  • ❌ No transitional protection removal without ministerial sign-off — cash and element transitional protections cannot be reduced or removed without formal ministerial review and parliamentary notification
  • ❌ No HMRC/DWP data sharing without GDPR lawful basis — all tax credit to UC data transfers must be underpinned by specific statutory gateway and Data Protection Impact Assessment
  • ❌ No debt recovery exceeding UC deduction cap — total deductions cannot exceed 25% of standard allowance (40% for fraud) without Hardship Payment provision and claimant notification
  • ❌ No vulnerable claimant forced digital-only access — domestic abuse survivors, mental health crisis, and digital exclusion cases must always have telephone and face-to-face claim routes available
